name: Secure Drive
summary: One encrypted file on your router's USB drive holds every document, spreadsheet, drawing and file, their versions and a signed access log. Only the computers and phones you approve hold the keys.

screenshots.alt: Secure Drive lists encrypted documents, a spreadsheet and drawing on a router share, with a verified log plus Files, Activity and Computers tabs

license.terms: Included under the ForkMesh repository licence.

permissions.label: Read and write the one encrypted drive file you pick, such as a file on a router's shared USB drive
Keep this device's drive keys in its private storage, locked by a passphrase you choose
Write a decrypted copy only when you choose Save a decrypted copy or Open in another app
Copy an invitation code you ask to copy, and clear it when you close the dialog
